items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Wins FDA Nod For First Dual Targeted Head And Neck Therapy
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE: JNJ) received FDA accelerated approval for RYBREVANT FASPRO in advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The therapy is described as the first dual targeted treatment option for this cancer type and is approved for second line use. RYBREVANT FASPRO now extends beyond its existing lung cancer indication, giving Johnson & Johnson a second major oncology use for the drug. items.title: Johnson & Johnson wins FDA approval for Rybrevant cancer treatment
items.summary: Investing.com-- Johnson & Johnson received accelerated approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Thursday for RYBREVANT FASPRO as a single-agent treatment for adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
